question: Approve this seed entering ideation to design the fix for the resolution-consume semantic hole — gate approval spent into status=done before delivery proof, leaving no send-back path when delivery later fails?

artifacts.summary: Seed filed from the captain's catch at z3's fo-boot-install-hint merge boundary: a gate approval on a terminal-target stage (validation->done) is consumed into status=done BEFORE delivery proof (push/PR/CI/merge), while verdict/completed/pr stay empty. If delivery then fails there is no in-model send-back: feedback-to is scoped pre-done, the consumed approval is irrevocable, and the pr-merge mod's failure path is report-and-wait; the pure-local-merge workflow hides it, any PR-gated workflow exposes it. Ideation designs the semantic where approval authority, stage status, and terminal fields cohere in both directions across the consume/delivery boundary.
